title: Questions 153-154 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
NOTICE

Attention all students in the marine biology program. The department encourages you to attend the closing session of this term’s guest speaker series, which will be held this Thursday in Rowan Hall. This event will address the restoration of coral habitats along developed coastlines.

The talk will be delivered by Adrian Kowalczyk. Mr. Kowalczyk is best known for directing a large-scale reef recovery program in Belize, a mangrove replanting effort in Kenya, and a seagrass monitoring network in Vietnam. His record is incomparable in the field. Students will be allowed to put questions to Mr. Kowalczyk after the presentation.
